definitions.explanation: The state of something that has not completely dried, especially laundry. Often associated with an unpleasant musty smell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生乾|なまがわ}きだ。

⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生乾|なまがわ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{部屋干|へやぼ}し→部屋干し：29859_heyaboshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{除湿機|じょしつき}→除湿機：06492_joshitsuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: During the rainy season, laundry tends to stay damp, so I use a dehumidifier when drying clothes indoors.

notes:
{生乾|なまがわ}き is composed of ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (raw, half-) + {乾|かわ}き (drying).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生乾|なまがわ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{臭|にお}い: musty smell from damp clothes
- {生乾|なまがわ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become half-dried
- {生乾|なまがわ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent damp laundry

USAGE: A very common term in daily life, especially during ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season) when drying laundry outdoors is difficult. The musty smell associated with {生乾|なまがわ}き is a frequent topic of conversation and advertising for laundry products.
